newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Disk drive shares seen firmer.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Disk drive shares seen firmer.

text.p: Shares in computer disk drive manufacturers were expected to open higher Thursday after Lehman Brothers started covering three of the companies with bullish recommendations, traders said.
Market sources confirmed Lehman initiated Western Digital Corp and Quantum Corp with buy recommendations and Seagate Technology Inc with an outperform rating.
In early third market trade, Quantum rose 1/8 to 43-7/8, while Western and Seagate were bid higher though untraded.
Seagate closed yesterday at 48-1/2 and Western at 63-7/8.
In other pre-open activity, Baan Co N.V.'s Nasdaq-listed shares climbed two to 57-5/8, while Intel edged up 1/8 to 152-7/8.
